from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,os,signal
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='b8a787b5b6c9df5bda03db4b5c9f3da67d80317a'
url='https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'tools/live_ats_inspect.py',url],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=75)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('DIAGNOSTIC_TIMEOUT')
print('INSPECT_EXIT',p.returncode,flush=True)
if p.returncode:
 print('INSPECT_ERROR',e[-600:],flush=True);raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
r=json.loads(o)
assert r['url_host']=='jobs.lever.co' and r['diagnostic_only'] is True
assert r['submission']=='not_attempted' and r['auth']=='not_attempted'
assert r['live_review']=='not_verified'
assert isinstance(r['rendered_text_length'],int) and r['rendered_text_length']>=0
assert r['empty_rendered_page']==(r['rendered_text_length']==0)
assert isinstance(r['unavailable_page_indicators'],list)
print('LIVE_RENDERED_PAGE_DIAGNOSTIC',json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
print('HEAD_UNCHANGED',git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base,flush=True)
